summary.text: Julie Menin represents the 5th District on the New York City Council, which includes the Upper East Side and Roosevelt Island, and was unanimously elected Speaker of the Council on January 7, 2026.
Her Council page says she previously led the city's Department of Consumer Affairs and the Office of Media and Entertainment and served as Census Director in 2020.

paragraphs.text: According to her Council page, Menin's small business was decimated on September 11, and she then helped guide Lower Manhattan's recovery as a non-profit founder and chair of Manhattan Community Board 1.
She is an attorney and a former adjunct professor at Columbia University, from which she graduated magna cum laude.
As Speaker, the page says, she has led efforts on economic and housing growth, a municipal college savings program, half-price transit discounts and an office to lower healthcare costs.
